items.title: Joe Bushkin interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I like the fact that Wynton Marsalis talks about Louis all the time. And I appreciate that.

ctx.x: This is “April in Portugal.” So that goes back a ways.

Well I’ll tell you, Louis Armstrong, I like the fact that Wynton Marsalis talks about Louis all the time. And I appreciate that. It makes me listen to him a little more carefully. And Louis was the Messiah of our music, there’s no two ways about it. And I don’t know how to put this except Louis was like a great, great obstetrician who delivered a thousand kids but didn’t have any of his own.
I think that’s a pretty good way to put it.
